lines.zh: 水压推着我慢慢往前漂
lines.en: The pressure pushes me drifting slowly forward.

lines.zh: 我这身子像一袋湿面团
lines.en: My body feels like a sack of wet dough.

lines.zh: 深水里的路没有尽头
lines.en: The deep water path never seems to end.

lines.zh: 鳍太小，划一下要歇一会
lines.en: My fins are tiny, so I rest between strokes.

lines.zh: 冷流从身边滑过去，很舒服
lines.en: The cold current slides past me, and it feels lovely.

lines.zh: 泥底软软的，踩不出脚印
lines.en: The muddy floor is soft and holds no footprints.

lines.zh: 我漂得慢，猎物也慢
lines.en: I drift slowly, and my prey is slow too.

lines.zh: 上面的光越来越淡了
lines.en: The light from above grows fainter and fainter.

lines.zh: 这团胶质身体省了不少力气
lines.en: This gelatinous body saves me a lot of effort.

lines.zh: 我往下沉一点，再滑一段
lines.en: I sink a little, then glide a stretch further.

lines.zh: 水草擦过肚子，痒痒的
lines.en: Water weeds brush my belly and tickle me.

lines.zh: 别催我，我天生就这速度
lines.en: Do not hurry me, this is my natural speed.

lines.zh: 一摆尾，全身都跟着晃
lines.en: One flick of the tail wobbles my whole body.

lines.zh: 越深越安静，我喜欢这样
lines.en: The deeper it gets, the quieter, and I like that.

lines.zh: 我随水流翻了个身。
lines.en: The current rolls me over.

lines.zh: 一块石头挡住我，我绕开。
lines.en: A stone blocks me. I drift around it.

lines.zh: 我就这样趴在海底发呆
lines.en: I just lie on the seafloor staring at nothing.

lines.zh: 大鼻子让我看起来总在难过
lines.en: My big nose makes me look permanently sad.

lines.zh: 有鱼路过，没认出我是活的
lines.en: A fish swam by and took me for a rock.

lines.zh: 胶质的身子在水里轻轻晃
lines.en: My gelatinous body sways gently in the water.

lines.zh: 我记得这里每一块石头
lines.en: I remember every single stone down here.

lines.zh: 上面那些亮闪闪的是什么
lines.en: What are all those shiny things up above?

lines.zh: 少吃一顿也不会饿，水里凉
lines.en: Skipping a meal is fine, the water keeps me cold.

lines.zh: 有人叫我丑，我倒觉得挺特别
lines.en: Some call me ugly, but I think I am quite special.

lines.zh: 气泡一串串升上去，像小灯
lines.en: Bubbles rise in strings like tiny lanterns.

lines.zh: 谁在水面上踩得那么响
lines.en: Who is stomping around so loudly up there?

lines.zh: 沙粒钻进褶子里，我抖一抖
lines.en: Sand gets in my folds, so I give a shake.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛小得几乎看不见
lines.en: My eyes are so small they are almost invisible.

lines.zh: 这地方冷，但安静得刚好
lines.en: It is cold here, but exactly quiet enough.

lines.zh: 一动不动才最像一块软石头
lines.en: Staying perfectly still is how I pass for soft stone.

lines.zh: 你在水边蹲着，是在看我吗
lines.en: You crouch at the water's edge; are you watching me?

lines.zh: 我这张脸把你吓到了吧
lines.en: My face must have startled you a little.

lines.zh: 别拍玻璃，我又不是展品
lines.en: Stop tapping the glass, I am not an exhibit.

lines.zh: 你身上有干岸的味道
lines.en: You carry the smell of dry land on you.

lines.zh: 我只看得清会动的东西
lines.en: I can only make out things that move.

lines.zh: 你蹲久了，膝盖会酸的
lines.en: Crouch like that long enough and your knees will ache.

lines.zh: 从上面看，我只是团淡淡的影子
lines.en: From up there I am only a pale shadow.

lines.zh: 你的倒影把光挡住了
lines.en: Your reflection is blocking my light.

lines.zh: 我努力抬头，脖子不太会弯
lines.en: I try to look up, but my neck barely bends.

lines.zh: 一直盯着我，我会不好意思
lines.en: Keep staring at me and I will get shy.

lines.zh: 我被戳到了，身上凹了一块
lines.en: Something poked me and left a dent.

lines.zh: 我的皮很薄，别用手抓
lines.en: My skin is thin, so do not grab me.

lines.zh: 疼得我整团都在抖
lines.en: The pain makes my whole lump shiver.

lines.zh: 我流血了吗，还是只是黏液
lines.en: Am I bleeding, or is that just slime?

lines.zh: 你砍我做什么，我又不好吃
lines.en: Why cut me? I do not even taste good.

lines.zh: 这一下让我沉到泥里去了
lines.en: That blow sent me sinking into the mud.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，希望你别再打
lines.en: I curl into a lump and hope you stop.

lines.zh: 深海里没什么会这样咬我
lines.en: Few things down deep bite me like that.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子最碰不得
lines.en: My nose is the part you must never touch.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里凉凉的，怪难受
lines.en: The wound feels cold in the water, and unpleasant.

lines.zh: 是虾吗，漂过来一点
lines.en: Is that shrimp? Drift a little closer.

lines.zh: 那小虫在动，我要定了
lines.en: That little worm is moving, and I want it.

lines.zh: 碎鱼肉的味道顺着水来了
lines.en: The smell of fish scraps travels down the water.

lines.zh: 别晃，我看不清它的位置
lines.en: Hold still, I cannot tell where it is.

lines.zh: 为了一口吃的，我肯挪半米
lines.en: For one bite I am willing to move half a meter.

lines.zh: 软软的东西最好吞了
lines.en: Soft things are the easiest to swallow.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西不够我塞牙
lines.en: That morsel in your hand will not even fill a tooth.

lines.zh: 我闻到壳里那点咸味了
lines.en: I can smell the salt inside that shell.

lines.zh: 慢一点，我怕它先跑掉
lines.en: Easier now, or it will get away first.

lines.zh: 这东西比海底的碎渣香多了
lines.en: This smells far better than the scraps on the seabed.

lines.zh: 撞上我了，我陷下去一块
lines.en: You bumped me, and a dent appeared.

lines.zh: 别推，胶质会自己弹回来
lines.en: Do not push, the jelly springs back on its own.

lines.zh: 我这么软，撞着也不疼吧
lines.en: I am so soft that bumping me cannot hurt.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶磕到我的鼻子
lines.en: The bucket in your hand knocked my nose.

lines.zh: 我又漂歪了，得重新找方向
lines.en: I drifted off course again and must find my bearing.

lines.zh: 挤过来，水都变暖了
lines.en: Squeeze in like that and the water warms up.

lines.zh: 小心点，我身上有层黏液
lines.en: Careful, I am covered in a layer of slime.

lines.zh: 碰到石头我都不躲，何况你
lines.en: I do not dodge stones, so why dodge you?

lines.zh: 这一下把我推到泥里了
lines.en: That shove sent me right into the mud.

lines.zh: 我慢，你走你的路吧
lines.en: I am slow, so just go on your way.

lines.zh: 那条更圆，我要游过去
lines.en: That one is rounder, and I will swim over.

lines.zh: 我们并排漂着就不算孤单
lines.en: Drifting side by side, neither of us is alone.

lines.zh: 深海太大，遇见同类不容易
lines.en: The deep sea is vast, and meeting your own kind is rare.

lines.zh: 你比我软，也比我小一点
lines.en: You are softer than me, and a bit smaller too.

lines.zh: 我们找个安静的泥坑待着
lines.en: Let us find a quiet mud hollow to settle in.

lines.zh: 别急，水流会把我们送到一起
lines.en: No rush, the current will carry us together.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，你也看得上吗
lines.en: Even with this face, do you still want me?

lines.zh: 尾巴碰一下，就算是约好了
lines.en: A touch of tails and we have agreed.

lines.zh: 以后这片海沟就有两个丑家伙
lines.en: From now on this trench holds two ugly fellows.

lines.zh: 靠近点，别让冷流冲散我们
lines.en: Stay close, so the cold current cannot part us.

lines.zh: 这块碎肉掉我嘴边了
lines.en: This scrap of meat landed right by my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用嘴一吸，它就进来了
lines.en: One suck of my mouth and it is inside.

lines.zh: 海底下也能捡到好东西
lines.en: You can find good things on the seabed too.

lines.zh: 沉下来的面包屑归我了
lines.en: The breadcrumb that sank down here is mine.

lines.zh: 我吞得慢，别抢走
lines.en: I swallow slowly, so do not snatch it away.

lines.zh: 这一小块够我嚼上半天
lines.en: This little piece will keep me chewing for ages.

lines.zh: 硬壳的我吐出来，只留软的
lines.en: I spit out the hard shell and keep the soft part.

lines.zh: 你丢下来的，我可就不还了
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I am not giving back.

lines.zh: 这味道像是从岸上来的
lines.en: This taste seems to have come from the shore.

lines.zh: 捡到宝了，虽然只是粒沙子
lines.en: Found a treasure, though it is only a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 我看见沙里动了一下
lines.en: I saw something stir inside the sand.

lines.zh: 那团小影子是我的晚饭
lines.en: That little shadow is my dinner.

lines.zh: 它躲进洞了，我记住了位置
lines.en: It ducked into a hole, and I have marked the spot.

lines.zh: 谁在啄我的尾巴，站出来
lines.en: Who pecked my tail? Step forward.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那只横着走的
lines.en: I have set my small eyes on that sideways walker.

lines.zh: 别以为我慢就抓不到你
lines.en: Do not think my slowness means I cannot catch you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的泥坑了，注意点
lines.en: You stepped in my mud hollow, so mind yourself.

lines.zh: 这只蟹壳厚，得找准缝隙
lines.en: That crab has a thick shell, so I need a gap.

lines.zh: 我难得有点脾气，别惹我
lines.en: I rarely get a temper, so do not provoke me.

lines.zh: 目标就在前面三寸的地方
lines.en: The target is just three inches ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我追得慢，但它也累了
lines.en: I chase slowly, but it is tiring too.

lines.zh: 跟着这股味道，别断
lines.en: Follow this smell, do not lose the trail.

lines.zh: 它绕石头，我也绕过去
lines.en: It goes around the stone, and so do I.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就能吸住它
lines.en: A little closer and I can suck it in.

lines.zh: 我尾巴摆得比平时快多了
lines.en: My tail is beating much faster than usual.

lines.zh: 这一路追得我肚子都饿了
lines.en: This chase has made me hungry all over again.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头我就咬空
lines.en: Do not turn back, or I will bite empty water.

lines.zh: 它往深处逃，正合我意
lines.en: It flees deeper, which suits me perfectly.

lines.zh: 我没什么牙，但嘴够大
lines.en: I have few teeth, but my mouth is wide.

lines.zh: 追到最后，它总要先停下
lines.en: In the end, it will have to stop first.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，它被弹开了
lines.en: I bumped into it and it bounced away.

lines.zh: 这一口吸空了，只吃到水
lines.en: That gulp caught nothing but water.

lines.zh: 我软软一撞，也算打过了
lines.en: A soft nudge from me still counts as a fight.

lines.zh: 别笑，我这两下很用力
lines.en: Do not laugh, I put effort into those two hits.

lines.zh: 它被我压住了，动弹不得
lines.en: I pressed down on it and it cannot move.

lines.zh: 我这身体，撞谁谁沾一手黏
lines.en: Hit me and you leave with a slimy hand.

lines.zh: 牙齿不多，咬合力也一般
lines.en: Not many teeth, and my bite is rather average.

lines.zh: 我把它顶进泥里，收工
lines.en: I shoved it into the mud and called it done.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我浑身都在颤
lines.en: One hit landed and my whole body is quivering.

lines.zh: 打完这架，我得歇很久
lines.en: After this fight I will need a long rest.

lines.zh: 我在深水里醒过来，四周很暗
lines.en: I woke in deep water with darkness all around.

lines.zh: 冷流把我从远处带到这里
lines.en: The cold current carried me here from far away.

lines.zh: 刚睁眼，世界就压在身上
lines.en: Just opened my eyes and the world pressed down.

lines.zh: 我好像从很深的地方升上来
lines.en: I seem to have risen from somewhere very deep.

lines.zh: 身边全是泥沙和碎贝壳
lines.en: It is all silt and broken shells around me.

lines.zh: 第一次浮起来，头有点晕
lines.en: My first time floating, and my head spins.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，只有气泡回答
lines.en: I called out and only bubbles answered.

lines.zh: 这里比原来的海沟暖和些
lines.en: This place is warmer than my old trench.

lines.zh: 我这条命，从水底开始算
lines.en: My life starts counting from the water's bottom.

lines.zh: 慢慢来，先学会怎么转弯
lines.en: Slowly now, first I learn how to turn.

lines.zh: 水边怎么会起火，烫死我了
lines.en: How is there fire by the water? It burns.

lines.zh: 掉下来摔在礁石上，身子扁了
lines.en: I fell onto the reef and my body flattened.

lines.zh: 我明明在水里，怎么还呛水
lines.en: I live in water, so how am I drowning?

lines.zh: 一声巨响，水都把我推远了
lines.en: A blast shoved me through the water.

lines.zh: 有东西从远处扎进我背上
lines.en: Something from afar stuck into my back.

lines.zh: 那道紫光让我的黏液发麻
lines.en: That purple light makes my slime tingle.

lines.zh: 好久没吃到小虾，肚子空了
lines.en: No shrimp for so long, my belly is empty.

lines.zh: 水里一道白光，我全身都麻
lines.en: A white flash in the water numbed me all over.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我一直在掉
lines.en: The seabed is gone and I keep dropping.
